mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations ( member_id, user_id, reservation_date, status, created_at, store_id, number ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{userId}, #{reservationDate}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{storeId}, #{number} )
mapper.select:
SELECT id, member_id AS memberId, user_id AS userId, reservation_date AS reservationDate, status, created_at AS createdAt, store_id AS storeId, number
FROM reservations
WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND user_id IS NULL
ORDER BY reservation_date DESC

FROM reservations
WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND member_id IS NULL
ORDER BY reservation_date DESC
